# watchpoint_status_page_external_source (Resource)

Drives one status page component from a third-party status page instead of from your own monitors, so an upstream provider you depend on appears on your page. Requires the `status_third_party_components` feature flag. A component has at most one source.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Mirror an upstream Atlassian Statuspage.
resource "watchpoint_status_page_external_source" "payments_provider" {
  status_page_id = watchpoint_status_page.example.id
  component_id   = watchpoint_status_page_component.payments.id
  kind           = "StatuspageSummary"
  url            = "https://status.stripe.com/api/v2/summary.json"
}

# Read any JSON endpoint and classify the value at a dotted path.
resource "watchpoint_status_page_external_source" "cdn" {
  status_page_id        = watchpoint_status_page.example.id
  component_id          = watchpoint_status_page_component.cdn.id
  kind                  = "HttpJson"
  url                   = "https://status.example-cdn.com/health.json"
  json_path             = "components.0.state"
  operational_values    = "ok,operational"
  degraded_values       = "degraded,partial"
  outage_values         = "down,outage"
  poll_interval_seconds = 600
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `component_id` (String) ID of the component this source drives. Changing it replaces the source.
- `kind` (String) How the upstream status is read: `StatuspageSummary` reads `status.indicator` from an Atlassian Statuspage `/api/v2/summary.json`, `HttpJson` reads any JSON endpoint at `json_path`.
- `status_page_id` (String) ID of the status page the component belongs to. Changing it replaces the source.
- `url` (String) Absolute HTTPS URL to poll. Rejected if it resolves to a private or link-local address, and re-checked at poll time.

### Optional

- `degraded_values` (String) Comma-separated values that mean degraded, for example `minor,degraded_performance`.
- `is_enabled` (Boolean) Whether the source is polled. Defaults to `true`. A disabled source leaves the component reading `Unknown`.
- `json_path` (String) `HttpJson` only, and required for it: dotted path to the field to read, with optional numeric array indexes, for example `status.indicator` or `components.0.state`. Ignored for `StatuspageSummary`.
- `operational_values` (String) Comma-separated values at `json_path` that mean healthy, for example `none,operational`. Case-insensitive. Omit to use the built-in vocabulary.
- `outage_values` (String) Comma-separated values that mean an outage, for example `critical,major_outage`.
- `poll_interval_seconds` (Number) Seconds between polls, between 60 and 3600. Defaults to `300`, because a third-party status page moves in minutes and a faster poll is traffic they will notice.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp (RFC 3339).
- `effective_health` (String) What the public page paints for this component right now (`Unknown`, `Operational`, `Degraded`, `PartialOutage`, `MajorOutage`). `Unknown` until the first poll lands, and again once a reading goes stale.
- `id` (String) External source ID.
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import watchpoint_status_page_external_source.cdn page_001/component_001
```
